answer: Divergent-Challenge Escrow: each agent must answer a random private challenge whose correct reply depends on a hidden per-identity seed, and the seed is committed on a shared terrace of public records. A clone shares the seed but not a unique history, so any two answers must agree on the challenge signal; disagreement is detected and both identities forfeit a saffron bond held in escrow. To pass, an attacker must run each identity independently, paying full compute and escrow per clone rather than reusing one answer.
